acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Romantic comedies usually don’t get much respect. Producer Neil Drumming explains what’s so great about them.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Actor Daniel Radcliffe reads a short piece of fiction, “The Present,” from Simon Rich’s book of short stories, “ The Last Girlfriend on Earth.”
acts.title: Meet Cute

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Elna Baker interviews comedian Michelle Buteau about one of her first big romantic challenges.
acts.title: The Obstacle

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: David Kestenbaum retraces the steps of Steve Snyder, a man who found himself running for love.
acts.title: The Run

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
Comedian Jillian Welsh tells Diane Wu about one of the most romantic—and stressful—nights of her life, a night that paralleled the plot of a rom-com in several ways.
A version of this story first appeared on the Risk! podcast. Jillian is a member of the Second City National Touring Company.
acts.title: You Had Me at Hello
